summary: Iteration 206 — A/B subject-line tests on Mira Outreach Autopilot. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (pick_subject unit, ab-stats aggregation with 12 fake qa-ab- leads inserted/cleaned, settings ab_test toggle off/on with summary + ab-stats enabled flag reflection, restaurant pitch-preview is_sample=false returning Snuzzles Cafe Jayanagar with distinct A/B subjects, salon pitch-preview with subject_b, and restaurant lead count >=10 with valid email_source/phone_source). Frontend AbSubjectPanel verified end-to-end: outreach-ab-panel scrolls into view, outreach-ab-toggle checked by default, chips outreach-ab-vert-salon / outreach-ab-vert-restaurant switch, outreach-ab-a and outreach-ab-b bars render, outreach-ab-total shows '0 A/B sends so far', toggle-off shows 'Autopilot paused' toast and label 'On — two subject lines per pitch' flips; toggle back on restores. Pitch preview dialog for restaurant shows pitch-preview-subject (A badge) + pitch-preview-subject-b (B badge, contains 'A/B test — half the leads get A, half get B'), and pitch-preview-lead reads 'next real lead in queue' (not sample) with 'Snuzzles Cafe Jayanagar · Bangalore · ★4.7 (283)'. Fake Mongo rows (qa-ab-*) cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: fix nested <button> inside <button> hydration warning in Super Admin layout (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: pick_subject() uses hex parse on last id char — if id ends with a non-hex char (e.g. '-' from uuid dash) it falls back to even/A gracefully via ValueError catch. OK, but a plain hash(id) % 2 would be more robust.
ab_stats endpoint does not index on subject_variant — scales to 5000 docs via to_list(5000). Add compound index {subject_variant:1, sent_at:-1} if volume grows.
ensure_subject_b performs an LLM call lazily on read-path (approve_and_send). Consider pre-generating on draft to avoid send-time latency / failure window.
